# BYTES LIKE matches bytes, not UTF-8 characters, including NUL and non-UTF-8 data.
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/operators.md

SELECT b'\xc3\xa9' LIKE b'_'
=> "false"

SELECT b'\xc3\xa9' LIKE b'__'
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff\x00\n' LIKE b'___'
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff\x00\n' LIKE b'%'
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xffabc' LIKE b'\xff%'
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xffabc' NOT LIKE b'\xfe%'
=> "true"

SELECT b'' LIKE b''
=> "true"

SELECT b'' LIKE b'_'
=> "false"

SELECT b'a%b_c\\' LIKE br'a\%b\_c\\'
=> "true"

SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(b'\xff' LIKE pattern AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY offset) FROM UNNEST([b'_', b'_', b'a', b'', b'\xff']) AS pattern WITH OFFSET AS offset
=> "true,true,false,false,true"

# GoogleSQL compliance: like_any.test, like_any_bytes_invalid.
SELECT value LIKE ANY (b'\\') FROM UNNEST([b'abc']) AS value
=> error: LIKE pattern ends with a backslash

SELECT value LIKE b'\\' FROM UNNEST([b'abc']) AS value
=> error: LIKE pattern ends with a backslash

# Quantified forms use the same byte matching with three-valued logic.
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/operators.md

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ANY (b'_', b'a')
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE SOME (b'a', b'\xff')
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ALL (b'_', b'%')
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' NOT LIKE ANY (b'_', b'a')
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' NOT LIKE ALL (b'a', b'b')
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ANY (b'_', CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ANY (b'a', CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ALL (b'_', CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ALL (b'a', CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> "false"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS BYTES) LIKE ANY (b'%')
=> null

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ANY UNNEST([b'a', b'_'])
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' LIKE ALL UNNEST([b'_', b'%'])
=> "true"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS BYTES) LIKE ANY UNNEST(ARRAY<BYTES>[])
=> "false"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS BYTES) LIKE ALL UNNEST(ARRAY<BYTES>[])
=> "true"

SELECT b'\xff' NOT LIKE ANY UNNEST(ARRAY<BYTES>[])
=> "false"

SELECT b'\xff' NOT LIKE ALL UNNEST(ARRAY<BYTES>[])
=> "true"
